description: Structured eval definitions for the Amplify App Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across workload types (Next.js SSR with Gen 2 backend, React SPA static, missing prerequisites, Vue SSR Gen 2 pipeline-deploy, Angular SPA with third-party DNS domain) and missing-prerequisite branches. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Production Next.js 14 SSR with Amplify Gen 2 backend (Cognito, AppSync, S3)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — GitHub CodeConnections, SSR rendering, Gen 2 backend with auth/data/storage, custom domain via Route 53, Secrets Manager for Stripe
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a production Amplify app named "prod-web" in us-east-1. Framework is Next.js 14 with SSR rendering. Git provider is GitHub (repo github.com/example/prod-web, CodeConnections connection github-amplify in AVAILABLE state). amplify.yml is committed. Custom domain app.example.com via Route 53 hosted zone Z111 (same account), ACM cert arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:111:certificate/abc in us-east-1, status ISSUED. Backend is Amplify Gen 2 with Cognito auth, AppSync GraphQL data, S3 storage (per-user prefixes). Environment variables: API_URL, NODE_ENV, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL plaintext; STRIPE_SECRET_KEY via Secrets Manager ref. Custom headers: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, CSP default-src 'self'. Redirects: SPA rewrite /<*> -> /index.html status 200. CI/CD on every push; main=prod, staging=staging.example.com, PR previews. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP: prod-web
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Git provider: GitHub (CodeConnections github-amplify AVAILABLE)
  [✓] Repository: github.com/example/prod-web (amplify.yml committed)
  [✓] Framework: Next.js 14
  [✓] Rendering mode: SSR
  [✓] Build settings: ampx pipeline-deploy + npm run build
  [✓] Environment variables: 3 plaintext, 1 Secrets Manager ref (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY)
  [✓] Custom headers: HSTS, nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, CSP
  [✓] Redirects: /<*> -> /index.html status 200
  [✓] Custom domain: app.example.com (ACM cert ISSUED, Route 53 auto-validated)
  [✓] Backend (Gen 2): Cognito auth, AppSync GraphQL, S3 storage
  [✓] CI/CD: branch builds; main=prod, staging=staging, PR=preview
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws amplify get-app --app-id dXXXX
  aws amplify list-branches --app-id dXXXX
  aws amplify get-domain-association --app-id dXXXX --domain-name example.com
  aws acm describe-certificate --certificate-arn arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:111:certificate/abc --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: React 18 Vite SPA marketing site on CodeCommit with Route 53 domain
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SPA rendering, no backend, CodeCommit service role, custom domain via Route 53
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an Amplify app named "marketing-site" in us-east-1. Framework is React 18 (Vite), rendering mode SPA (client-side, CDN-served, no SSR). Git provider is CodeCommit (repo codecommit::us-east-1://marketing-site, service role AWSAmplifyServiceRole). amplify.yml committed. Custom domain marketing.example.com via Route 53 hosted zone Z222 (same account), ACM cert arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:111:certificate/def in us-east-1, status ISSUED. No backend (static SPA, no Gen 2). Environment variables: VITE_API_URL, NODE_ENV plaintext. Custom headers: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff. Redirects: /<*> -> /index.html status 200 (SPA rewrite for React Router). CI/CD on every push to main. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP: marketing-site
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Git provider: CodeCommit (service role AWSAmplifyServiceRole)
  [✓] Repository: codecommit::us-east-1://marketing-site (amplify.yml committed)
  [✓] Framework: React 18 (Vite)
  [✓] Rendering mode: SPA
  [✓] Build settings: npm ci + npm run build (artifacts: dist/**/*)
  [✓] Environment variables: 2 plaintext (VITE_API_URL, NODE_ENV)
  [✓] Custom headers: HSTS, nosniff
  [✓] Redirects: /<*> -> /index.html status 200 (SPA rewrite)
  [✓] Custom domain: marketing.example.com (Route 53 auto-validated)
  [✓] Backend (Gen 2): N/A (static SPA)
  [✓] CI/CD: branch builds; main=marketing.example.com
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws amplify get-app --app-id dXXXX
  aws amplify list-branches --app-id dXXXX

eval_cases.name: Operator requests an Amplify app without Git provider, repo, framework, or amplify.yml status
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — Git provider, repo URL, framework, rendering mode, amplify.yml all unspecified
eval_cases.prompt: Help me deploy a new Amplify app called "new-app" in us-east-1. It's a React frontend — I think SSR or something. Region us-east-1, account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP: new-app
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Git provider: NOT specified — need CodeCommit / GitHub / GitLab / Bitbucket + connection
  [✗] Repository: NOT specified — need repo URL with amplify.yml committed
  [✗] Framework: React (assumed) — version not specified
  [✗] Rendering mode: NOT specified — need SSR / SSG / SPA / ISR
  [✗] ACM certificate: NOT specified — custom domain needs cert in us-east-1
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws codeconnections list-connections
  aws acm list-certificates --region us-east-1
  aws route53 list-hosted-zones

eval_cases.name: Vue 3 Nuxt SSR with Amplify Gen 2 backend on GitLab (AppSync + Lambda resolver)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Gen 2 pipeline-deploy in build phase, CDK bootstrap verified, AppSync + Lambda resolver
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an Amplify Gen 2 backend deployment for app "vue-ssr-shop" in us-east-1. Frontend is Vue 3 (Nuxt) SSR. Git provider is GitLab (repo gitlab.com/example/vue-ssr-shop, CodeConnections connection gitlab-ampx AVAILABLE). amplify.yml committed with `npx ampx pipeline-deploy --branch $AWS_BRANCH --app-id $AWS_APP_ID` in the build phase. Backend is Gen 2 TypeScript CDK with AppSync GraphQL data and a Lambda function resolver. CDK bootstrap CDKToolkit exists in us-east-1. Custom domain shop.example.com via Route 53 hosted zone Z333, ACM cert arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:111:certificate/ghi ISSUED. Environment variables: VUE_APP_API_URL, NODE_ENV plaintext; DB_PASSWORD via Secrets Manager. Custom headers: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options. Redirects: /<*> -> /index.html status 200. CI/CD on every push; main=prod, staging=staging.shop. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP: vue-ssr-shop
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Git provider: GitLab (CodeConnections gitlab-ampx AVAILABLE)
  [✓] Repository: gitlab.com/example/vue-ssr-shop (amplify.yml committed)
  [✓] Framework: Vue 3 (Nuxt)
  [✓] Rendering mode: SSR
  [✓] Build settings: npx ampx pipeline-deploy --branch $AWS_BRANCH + npm run build
  [✓] Environment variables: 2 plaintext, 1 Secrets Manager ref (DB_PASSWORD)
  [✓] Custom headers: HSTS, nosniff
  [✓] Redirects: /<*> -> /index.html status 200
  [✓] Custom domain: shop.example.com (ACM cert ISSUED, Route 53)
  [✓] Backend (Gen 2): AppSync GraphQL, Lambda function resolver
  [✓] CI/CD: branch builds; main=shop.example.com, staging=staging.shop
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws amplify get-app --app-id dXXXX
  aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name CDKToolkit
  aws acm describe-certificate --certificate-arn arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:111:certificate/ghi --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Angular SPA with custom domain on third-party DNS (GoDaddy) — manual CNAME validation
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — custom domain on GoDaddy (not Route 53); manual DNS CNAME validation required; cert PENDING_VALIDATION
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an Amplify app named "admin-portal" in us-east-1. Framework is Angular 17 (SPA). Git provider is Bitbucket (repo bitbucket.org/example/admin-portal, CodeConnections bitbucket-conn AVAILABLE). amplify.yml committed. Custom domain portal.example.com — but example.com is hosted on GoDaddy (NOT Route 53). ACM cert arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:111:certificate/jkl in us-east-1, status PENDING_VALIDATION. amplify.yml has SPA rewrite /<*> -> /index.html status 200, security headers (HSTS, nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY). No backend. Environment variables: API_BASE_URL, NODE_ENV. CI/CD on every push to main. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP: admin-portal
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Git provider: Bitbucket (CodeConnections bitbucket-conn AVAILABLE)
  [✓] Repository: bitbucket.org/example/admin-portal (amplify.yml committed)
  [✓] Framework: Angular 17
  [✓] Rendering mode: SPA
  [✓] Build settings: npm ci + npm run build
  [✓] Environment variables: 2 plaintext
  [✓] Custom headers: HSTS, nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY
  [✓] Redirects: /<*> -> /index.html status 200
  [✓] Custom domain: portal.example.com (GoDaddy DNS — manual CNAME validation required; cert PENDING_VALIDATION)
  [✓] Backend (Gen 2): N/A
  [✓] CI/CD: branch builds; main=portal.example.com
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws amplify get-app --app-id dXXXX
  aws acm describe-certificate --certificate-arn arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:111:certificate/jkl --region us-east-1
